Stashed deep in its lowest hold lies a coveted stash of plunder known as the Southsea Treasure. Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin scoundrel operating out of Ratchet, considers it the ultimate test for aspiring pickpockets. According to Wrenix, the last five operatives sent to filch the chest returned in pieces, owing to the alert pirates aboard and a surprisingly ferocious guardian guarding the hold.

Thieves who manage to bypass the pirate trainers and pick the lock on the target chest find a vicious surprise waiting for them. Rather than sitting loose inside the coffer, the true Southsea Treasure is watched over by Polly, an unnaturally hostile parrot. Overcoming the vicious avian—often with the aid of goblin engineering such as Wrenix's E.C.A.C. device—is the only way to pry the treasure loose and bring it back to Ratchet intact.
